Details.JobSummary: Provide nursing care to patients in an outpatient clinic.
MajorDuties: Assess, plan, carry out and evaluate nursing care for adult patients seen in a primary care clinic.
Give medications and treatments as ordered and record care in the electronic health record.
Teach patients and families about care plans, medications and follow-up visits.
Work with physicians, pharmacists and social workers to coordinate each patient's care.
Details.Requirements: Must be a U.S. citizen. Must pass a background check and a pre-employment physical.
Details.Education: A degree or diploma from a nursing program accredited at the time of graduation.

MatchedObjectDescriptor.QualificationSummary: To qualify, you must hold a current, full and unrestricted registered nurse license in a State, the District of Columbia or a U.S. territory, and have at least one year of professional nursing experience in an ambulatory or outpatient care setting.

Details.JobSummary: Design and teach continuing-education courses for nursing staff.
